describe.description: The creature is shown in strict right-facing profile standing on two legs against a plain light background. It has the overall form, plumage and stance of a large brown eagle from the head to the mid-body, with a robust feathered torso, folded wings, and thick feathered legs ending in large taloned feet, but the lower body and rear show octopus-like features. The head, neck, chest, back and wings are covered in dense overlapping brown feathers in shades of golden-brown to dark brown, the wings folded flat against the sides. The thighs and shanks bear pale circular sucker-like discs on the skin among the feathers, and from the rear underneath the folded wingtips where a feathered tail would normally be, a cluster of thick, fleshy brown tentacles with rows of white-rimmed suckers hangs down and curls at the tips. The feet are large, yellow and scaly with long black curved talons.
